This hybrid position is based in Sydney and offers occasional domestic and international travel opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of multiple digital transformation projects.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules and delivery roadmaps.
  • Manage project scope, budgets, risks, resources and timelines.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers and senior stakeholders.

  • Drive Agile delivery practices across Scrum and Kanban environments.
  • Manage customer escalations and facilitate timely resolution.
  • Monitor project financials and ensure delivery aligns with agreed budgets.
  • Support compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements.
  • Encourage strong project governance, transparency and accountability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams within a matrix organisation.
Technical Requirements Essential:
  • 5-10+ years' experience in project delivery and stakeholder management within digital transformation environments.
  • Proven success managing multiple projects across a diverse customer portfolio.
  • Strong experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar Agile management tools.
  • Experience using project scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.
  • Strong financial management and budget control capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage scope, risks, priorities and resources across complex programmes.
Desired Experience Highly regarded:
  • Building digital roadmaps aligned to client transformation objectives.
  • Working closely with Brand, Marketing and Communications functions.
  • Collaborating with Architecture Review Boards and technical governance teams.
  • Managing third-party technology vendors and partners.
  • Overseeing the work of Project Managers across multiple engagements.
  • Driving project management process improvement initiatives.
  • Delivering projects across ANZ and Southeast Asia.
This role offers the opportunity to influence major digital transformation outcomes while working across a varied portfolio of projects and customers. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery leadership to help organisations achieve meaningful business outcomes through technology.
